recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中僅見一個細胞核深染、胞質淡藍且邊緣不規則的單核細胞，以及數個血小板與形態正常的紅血球；此圖本身沒有可辨認 PV 的特異線索，需依賴血球數值與 JAK2 檢測。
features: Single medium-sized mononuclear cell with high N:C ratio and irregular, angulated cell outline
Nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin; no distinct nucleoli clearly resolved
Scant pale-to-moderately basophilic cytoplasm without granules or Auer rods
Normochromic, normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
Several platelets, including a few large forms, in the background
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic, normocytic red cells with several platelets, including occasional large forms. A single mononuclear cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, moderately condensed chromatin, and scant agranular, pale-blue cytoplasm with an irregular outline is present; it most likely represents a lymphocyte, although a circulating immature cell cannot be excluded on a single cell. No specific morphologic features of polycythemia vera are evident in this field; red cell mass and crowding cannot be assessed from a thin-area field. The diagnosis of polycythemia vera requires correlation with hemoglobin/hematocrit, JAK2 mutation status, and bone marrow morphology.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are larger with more abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells, whereas this cell has scant cytoplasm and a high N:C ratio.
Blasts show finely dispersed chromatin with visible nucleoli, which are not clearly seen in this cell.
Blood morphology cannot separate PV from secondary erythrocytosis; JAK2 V617F/exon 12 mutation and a low serum EPO favor PV.
